This is also what makes it a SHOULDER structure rather than a back-only one. | FMA, as recorded in NCI Thesaurus: The transverse part is a has_regional_part of the right trapezius, establishing the three named parts as siblings under one muscle. A sibling part, not the one in question. | Product decision: Authoritative anatomy sources establish that trapezius consists of descending/superior, transverse/middle and ascending/inferior MUSCULAR parts.
